title: Imp Jar Select Strawberry Raspberry & Cherry Ice 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: Imp Jar Select Strawberry, Raspberry and Cherry Ice is a rich berry medley. It features layers of tart tasting Cherries fused with notes of sweet Strawberries and the distinct tang of Raspberries, all lifted by a refreshing icy finish. The Imp Jar Select nic salt range utilise twice as much flavour concentrate as standard e-liquids for an intense flavour payoff which pairs perfectly with starter kits and refillable pod kits. Launched in conjunction with Imp Jar's first pod vape kit, the Imp Jar Select, Imp Jar Select Nic Salts are available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg strengths, allowing you to tailor your vaping experience. This 10ml e-liquid is TPD-compliant and features a childproof cap and tamper-evident seal.
